latest_release.name: MuseScore Studio 4.7.7 Release
latest_release.body:
### MuseScore Studio 4.7.7 is now available!

This update adds updated translations, support for FFMPEG 9, some small improvements to instruments, as well as fixes for several bugs and crashes.

To learn more, see the full announcements for [4.7.7](https://musescore.org/en/4.7.7) and [4.7](https://musescore.org/en/4.7).

And don't forget to check out the [4.7 release video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=grKX-cBEEmM)!
